meta.title: Base ERP Rate Table - for Passenger Cars, Taxis and Light Goods Vehicles
meta.time_period_note: A period such as 07:30 - 08:00 applies from and including 07:30 until but excluding 08:00.
meta.empty_cell_note: The PDF leaves cells blank where no ERP charge applies. Those periods are not listed in 'rates'; treat them as 0.
meta.rate_note: 'rate_sgd' is the base rate for passenger cars, taxis and light goods vehicles. Multiply by 'vehicle_multipliers' for other vehicle types.
meta.name_note: 'name' is the road or spot for that one gantry. Where a PDF column name lists several places separated by commas (for example 'CTE northbound between PIE and Braddell Road, PIE to CTE northbound before Braddell Road'), the name is split at the commas and matched to the column's gantry numbers in the order the PDF lists them. Columns without commas keep the whole column name for every gantry in them. Where there are no commas but the column joins places with 'and' (for example 'YMCA Gantry and Fort Canning Tunnel Gantry'), it is split at 'and' the same way. The PDF does not label which gantry is which; the order match was confirmed for gantries 46, 67, 92 and 93 and the same rule is used for the rest.
meta.gantry_note: One entry per gantry number. 'location' comes from the PDF's reference tables (Refer #1, #2, #3), which only cover the Orchard Cordon and Rest of CBD gantries. Other gantries have no individual location in the PDF, only the description of the road section they belong to ('charging_point_name').
meta.period_note: Back-to-back periods with the same charge are merged into one (for example 11:05 - 11:25, 11:25 - 11:30 and 11:30 - 11:35 at $1.00 become 11:05 - 11:35). Periods with a different charge, and gaps where there is no charge, are kept as they are. A merged period runs from its start up to but excluding its end.
meta.shared_rate_note: Gantries that sit in the same PDF column share one set of rates ('shares_rate_with_gantries'). The PDF gives one charge per column, not a separate charge per gantry.

day_types.weekday: All three sections (Orchard Cordon and Rest of CBD, Arterial Roads, Expressways).
day_types.saturday: The PDF has Saturday columns for the Orchard Cordon and Rest of CBD section only, and all of them are blank in this edition, so there are no Saturday rates. Arterial roads and expressways have no Saturday columns.
